articles.title: ‘I saw him as an avatar of Vishnu’: Bhutan PM Tshering Tobgay lauds 'elder brother' PM Modi’s 25 years in public office
articles.summary: Bhutan PM Tshering Tobgay called PM Narendra Modi an “avatar of Vishnu” while praising his 25-year political journey. Tobgay linked Modi’s leadership to wisdom, compassion, courage and selfless service, calling them qualities of an enlightened ruler.

articles.title: Vivek Agnihotri sparks ‘tax religion’ row, VHP seeks apology from Kashmir Files director
articles.summary: Kainchi Dham in Uttarakhand has experienced severe, unprecedented overcrowding and massive traffic jams, driven by the Gandhi Jayanti long weekend and heightened public interest following the release of the film Hanuman Ansh.&nbsp;

articles.title: Nobel Prize 2026: How JNU scientist Suneel Kateriya helped lay the groundwork for optogenetics
articles.summary: JNU professor Suneel Kateriya identified two light-sensing genes in a single-celled alga during his PhD in Germany. More than two decades later, the discovery forms part of the scientific foundation behind optogenetics, the technology recognised by the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

articles.title: What happens to 'energy drinks' after Campa, PepsiCo get interim court relief against FSSAI label ban? | Explained
articles.summary: As Reliance’s Campa, PepsiCo and Monster receive interim relief from the Delhi High Court against an FSSAI order prohibiting them from marketing high-caffeine beverages as “energy drinks”, the question remains: What happens to the existing stock?

articles.summary: Piyush Goyal held meetings with senior executives of leading US companies in New York this week.

articles.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting could reshape rules on tax refunds, input tax credit, enforcement, buyer protection and the frequency of GST rate changes.

articles.title: 3 years of October 7 attack: ‘Never take the enemy lightly’ — What went wrong for Israel? Expert weighs in
articles.summary: Three years after the October 7 Hamas attack, questions remain over Israel’s intelligence and security failures. Expert Khinvraj Jangid says overconfidence about Hamas, political turmoil and misreading the threat exposed vulnerabilities, offering lessons for India on national security.
